name: stripecard
blurb: Card with gradient overlay and sliding image reveal on hover.
description: A product-like card with blue gradient overlay that reveals on hover. Image slides and scales; a CTA link slides in from below.
use_when: E-commerce product cards or feature showcases where image reveal on hover creates engagement and guides to details.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where persistent reveal state could be confusing or block content.
a11y: Image has alt text; link is keyboard accessible. Overlay gradient is visual embellishment.
